title: [CI] Download only selected UI test folders in slim test jobs

status.label: Review in progress
status.detail: Windows PowerShell 5.1 and Pester 3.4 executed the ten-case fixture once: one static route check passed and nine cases failed on a private fixture's blank-line parameter binding before the changed YAML logic ran. The child exited and the exclusive lock was released; this is not evidence of a PR defect. Allowing valid empty source lines is now prepared and statically parsed, but has not been runtime-validated. Source review also found that fixture sample paths omitted the full staged artifact prefix, so those samples are being aligned with the real artifact layout. Azure task matching, template expansion, CRLF behavior and path preservation still require separate evidence; a feature-head slim-run plan exists, but queue access and the required runners are unverified and no workflow was queued. The saved Copilot request remains ended unmatched, not clean.

next_action: Resume the saved review stage in the next dashboard update.
